correctness.rationale: Finite PGL2 classification proves exact full automorphism presentation; all S3 subgroups must contain the unique C3 and one involution from its coset. Conjugation modulo 2k has exactly two parity orbits. Geometric fixed sets give one inertia-3 orbit plus 0 or 4 inertia-2 orbits; Riemann–Hurwitz gives genera. Algebraic invariant fields give two classical quotient models. Checker independently replays finite group cases 1..15, not replacing infinite proof.
